output.brief: The evidence points to the 2 Nov compaction tuning change on the storage nodes, not gateway 5.8. That change (FC-7710) was pushed about 23:38–23:52, and it wasn't on the change calendar. It took compaction threads from 2 to 6. Disk use then jumped from 41% to 97% within five minutes, and node-side GET time went from 61 to 262 ms. Every cell that got the push regressed within minutes, whatever its gateway timing. Cell aps-3 skipped the push, runs 5.8 and stayed at 94 ms. Rolling euw-1 back to 5.7 changed nothing. Network and traffic growth don't fit: GET volume rose only 6%, and the one network fault was a short, single-region event. A fleet-wide rollback would not help and would reopen the security hole (audit deadline 30 Nov). Don't pause compaction either, since backlog was already 11%. Next step: revert FC-7710 in one cell, watch p99 and backlog, then extend it to the rest. Keep 5.8. Ask for fleet config changes to be posted to the shared calendar. Hold off on throttling Orrin until the 10 Nov backlog attribution report. I'm fairly confident, about 85–90%.
